verdict.rationale: Gitea is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service offering "full control". Its data sits in standard databases the operator runs (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL and others), and every instance exposes a documented, versioned REST API described in Swagger/OpenAPI, so code and records can be retrieved in open formats. However, the pack documents no first-party export or dump feature that packages all data (issues, PRs, wikis, packages) for leaving, and a community user questioned whether good backup/restore exists. missing for 10: a documented all-data export/dump tool, a documented export format for issues/PRs/metadata, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-leave path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
Offers seamless integration with leading databases, including SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, and MS SQL.
The OpenAPI document is at: https://gitea.your.host/swagger.v1.json
